messages:
Marta (content): Idea: run a 2-week "mini codewalk" around our OSS refapp with a short launch post + 15-min community webinar. Make it super bite-sized for folks to run and report benchmarks.
Ken (growth): 👍 good. Low friction = higher signups. Recommend gated webinar + gated replay. We can A/B replay gating.
Rina (devrel): I'll prepare a 'snippet sprint' repo with 1-command quickstart and one benchmark script. Keep Docker + Colab options. Example snippet for landing:
```
docker run --rm -p8080:8080 redwood/miniref:0.1 && 
curl -X POST localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize KV cache"}'
```
Jules (design): I'll make a tiny hero gif showing run -> results, and 2 social cards (short/long). Need hero copy.
Marta (content): Hero drafts: A) "Mini Codewalk: run a refapp, see real benches" B) "Snippet sprint: measure inference in minutes" Thoughts?
Ken (growth): A lands better with devs. Routing: register -> HubSpot list "mini_codewalk_2024"; add qualifier field "enterprise_interest" to route to SDRs.
Acho (analytics): UTMs: utm_source=mini_codewalk, utm_campaign=snippet_sprint_q3. Track event quickstart_run and bench_report_submit. I'll set up a dashboard.
Rina (devrel): For the benchmark narrative: we'll publish p50/p95 + tokens/sec across 3 model sizes; include CSV and a condensed chart for the blog.
Jules (design): CTAs: "Try the snippet" (GitHub) and "Join the demo" (register). I'll mock both states (before/after run) for the hero.
Marta (content): Assignments: blog + copy = Marta, landing + registration = Ken, repo & demo = Rina, design = Jules, tracking = Acho.
Ken (growth): I'll wire the HubSpot form and default tags. Replay gating experiment: 50/50 open vs gated. We'll monitor signups and demo requests.
hubspot-bot: list_created: mini_codewalk_2024 (ID: 13579)
Acho (analytics): I'll instrument an image-pixel ping from the quickstart to mark successful runs so we can measure activation rate.
Marta (content): Timeline: drafts due Tue, landing up Thu, webinar Fri 2024-07-19 15:00 UTC. Check-in Wed 11am PT. Keep social hooks metric-first (e.g., "See 2x lower tail latency with cache").
Rina (devrel): I'll add a Colab and one-line BigQuery export for community contributors to add results.
Marta (content): Great—I'll drop a short brief in the shared drive and tag owners. Thanks team :raised_hands:
